candidates.change_summary: Replace the revert guard that prevents re-setting MinSum when initialized with an unconditional assignment allowing MinSum to be set even after initialization.
Remove the require check in the nonReentrant_ modifier so the reentrancy lock is not enforced, allowing SetMinSum to execute without the guard blocking on locked_.
Remove the guard that reverts when already initialized by changing the conditional to allow SetMinSum to overwrite MinSum even if intitalized is true (i.e., delete the revert check).

Remove the reentrancy protection by deleting the modifier body so functions using nonReentrant_ no longer lock, allowing reentrant calls that can affect when SetMinSum completes in presence of reentrancy.
